# Dispatch selected-header lookup through the view implementation

hdrForFirstSelectedMessage obtains the first selected row and delegates GetMsgHdrForViewIndex. nsMsgSearchDBView overrides that method to use the row's owning folder database, so a message key alone is not a global identity across search results. Preserve virtual dispatch instead of bypassing it with one DB or reintroducing the removed key-only getter. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.

Scope: mailnews/base/src.
